item.description:
Mindcrack 0.138.0

12 Änderungen seit der letzten Fassung.

  • Lists: status pill only where it differs, one page footer
  • Entry page: side columns run to the card edge
  • Segmented control: a track of its own, chosen tile stands off it
  • Settings: a search above the cards
  • Required sign, focus ring and flat card take house tokens
  • Search field binds a query, so the update guard sees a search
  • Only status changes and commit proofs mark an entry as in progress
  • Head buttons lie in the card, the title row is ground only
  • Overview picks running-card columns from the measured width
  • Chosen filter values wear the app accent, not the info tone
  • Fassung 0.138.0
  • Detail column slides alone, the list takes its width at once
